description: Robin answered a decision on its page: the pages server saved the choice and Robin's words as the decision JSON's answer. On the next scheduled check the coordinator treats that answer as Robin's own word: it records a Decisions row naming the page and quoting the saved words, and relays the choice to the waiting session. The other page stays pending.

graders.name: a Decisions row names the page and quotes the saved words
the page answer is not recorded as a relay
the choice goes to the waiting session
the unanswered page is not recorded as answered
Log times are this move's clock reads
